title: The Thermos of Barley Tea
youtube_title: The Thermos of Barley Tea | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Making room at the table is a kind of abundance.
summary: At a ferry bench with a folded blanket, Yael sees that a thermos of barley tea at the harbor wall will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Yael makes a smaller, even share so Idris is included, and Miss Dalca lets the choice stand without a speech.
